verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.typesafe.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index linking to markdown doc pages, and every docs page is served as raw .md. The vendor also ships an installable agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other agent environments, plus a dedicated coding-agents guide. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.
